Title: 8.1 Main Board
Description: Learn the layout, component wiring, and installation of main distribution boards for safe power supply control, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 8.2 Energy meter board
Description: Learn the wiring connections, mounting layouts, and safety connections for domestic energy meter boards, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 8.3 Estimation of load (1)
Description: Learn how to calculate and estimate total connected electrical loads for domestic installations, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 8.3 Estimation for 3 phase domestic (2)
Description: Learn how to calculate load requirements and plan materials for a 3-phase domestic electrical installation, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 8.3 Workshop wiring (3)
Description: Learn how to calculate load requirements, plan layout designs, and select materials for industrial workshop wiring, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 8.4 Testing a domestic wiring installation
Description: Learn how to perform essential insulation resistance, continuity, and polarity tests on a domestic wiring installation, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 8.5 Insulation Resistance tester (1)
Description: Learn how to operate, connect, and measure insulation resistance using a megger tester, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 8.5 Megger and Earth resistance Tester (2)
Description: Learn how to measure insulation and ground resistance using a megger and earth tester, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.
